evidence.quote: In the rate law the symbol I denotes the free inhibitor concentration, i.e. the declared state with dI/dt = 0. It does not include enzyme-bound inhibitor. Use dS/dt = -Vmax*S/(Km*(1 + I/KI) + S) with I constant at I(0).
